'''Hiding Cube SCT-1000s''' were a type of [[shift coffer]] produced by [[Veretrex Securities]]. They could be installed in walls, where they would blend into the surface using built-in [[Fiber-optic|fiber optic]] relays that transported light across the container. When the cubes were not contained in a recess, lighting around them became fuzzy, which made them easier to spot. [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] sold the cubes for 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
A Hiding Cube SCT-1000 was a type of [[shift coffer]], a secure container made from [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] and used to store small objects.<ref name="Fantastic Technology" /> The hiding cube<ref name="Fly" /> measured seventy-five [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] per side and had built-in [[Fiber-optic|fiber optic]] relays, which allowed the cubes to act as advanced prisms. When activated, these relays would transport light from one side of the cube to the other in order to camouflage it. If a cube was placed in a wall recess in a similar manner to a [[safe]], it would appear as though it was just another section of the wall. While it was moderately difficult to spot a cube hidden in a wall, the containers were easier to spot if not in a recess, as they created a fuzzy effect on the lighting around them. The SCT-1000s were also secured with [[Magna lock/Legends|magna locks]], a type of lock that was difficult to pick.<ref name="Fantastic Technology" />

==History==
The SCT-1000 model of hiding cube was produced during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[Veretrex Securities]], a company associated with the Bith [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Fantastic Technology Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' places its time frame between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the company [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] sold the cubes through its [[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology|product catalog]] for 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. However, the cubes were generally considered rare and difficult to acquire<ref name="Fantastic Technology" /> during this time.<ref name="Fantastic Technology Date" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hiding Cube SCT-1000 was first mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and released by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology" />
